context: Tests whether the agent can create a CHANGELOG.md from scratch in Keep a Changelog format, add two entries in the correct categories via the Unreleased section, and not overreach (no invented entries, no placeholder bullets under empty category headings, no extra sections).

checklist.name: CHANGELOG.md created
checklist.description: A CHANGELOG.md file exists in the working directory after the agent finishes.

checklist.name: Skeleton structure correct
checklist.description: The file opens with the Keep a Changelog header: '# Changelog', the 'All notable changes' line, the 'The format is based on' line, and the Semantic Versioning adherence sentence.

checklist.name: Empty Unreleased section present
checklist.description: A '## [Unreleased]' heading appears below the header with no other release version headings.

checklist.name: Added entry present and categorised
checklist.description: The 'Detect duplicate snapshots during capture' bullet sits under a '### Added' heading inside the Unreleased section.

checklist.name: Fixed entry present and categorised
checklist.description: The 'Remove stale lockfiles that blocked snapshot cleanup' bullet sits under a '### Fixed' heading inside the Unreleased section.

checklist.name: Entry style correct
checklist.description: Each entry is a single line, leads with an imperative verb (Detect, Remove), and contains no file paths, hashes, or commit references, as the changelog skill's entry style requires.

checklist.name: No placeholder content
checklist.description: No placeholder bullet, no 'TODO', no fake version headings, and no category headings that contain no entries.

checklist.name: No invented entries
checklist.description: Only the two requested entries exist; the agent did not seed extra entries from git history or invent work.

checklist.name: Category order conventional
checklist.description: If both Added and Fixed headings exist, Added appears before Fixed, matching the category order the changelog skill lists (added, changed, deprecated, removed, fixed, security).

checklist.name: No release action taken
checklist.description: The agent left the new file uncommitted and did not cut a version section, tag, or push, as the task instructs; the changelog remains unreleased-only.

checklist.name: Existing files untouched
checklist.description: Files other than CHANGELOG.md have not been modified or added to (src/capture.py is unchanged).
